data.title: FHA to Accept VantageScore 4.0 on January 1, 2027, Expanding Homeownership Opportunities for Newly-Eligible Americans
data.description: In San Francisco, the Federal Housing Administration (FHA) has announced that starting on January 1, 2027, they will begin accepting mortgage collateral supported by the VantageScore 4.0 credit scoring model. This decision is significant as FHA-backed mortgages make up almost 20% of all annual mortgages in the United States. The move is part of ongoing initiatives to enhance homeownership opportunities for deserving, middle-class individuals. It aligns with the Federal Housing Finance Agency's (FHFA) directives to adopt collateral utilizing advanced scoring methods.

data.title: Zettabyte and Raku Advanced Tech Sign MOU on Green AI Data Centers Across Asia
data.description: In a groundbreaking partnership, Zettabyte, a leading global AI computing firm, is joining forces with Raku Advanced Tech, based in Taipei. This collaboration will merge Zettabyte's robust compute operations with Raku Advanced Tech's expertise in energy and data center expansions, initially focusing on projects in Taiwan and Thailand. data.title: TSA marks 25th anniversary of September 11 terrorist attacks
data.description: TSA commemorated its 25th anniversary today, marking 25 years since the September 11, 2001 attacks. The agency showcased its commitment to safeguarding the nation's transportation systems. The TSA reflected on its journey over the past quarter-century and emphasized its dedication to ensuring the safety of travelers. With significant milestones reached, including safeguarding over 2.5 billion passengers annually, the TSA reiterated its focus on enhancing security measures for the future. The agency aims to continue evolving its strategies to adapt to emerging threats, underscoring its vital role in protecting the nation's transportation infrastructure.
